items.source: Return a hash code based on the contents of the specified array. If array is null, this method returns 0.
items.translation: 返回基于指定数组内容的哈希码。如果array为null，则此方法返回 0。

items.source: Return a String representation of the contents of the specified array.
items.translation: 返回指定数组内容的字符串表示形式。

items.source: array - the array to build a String representation for
items.translation: array - 要构建字符串表示形式的数组

items.source: a String representation of array
items.translation: `array` 的字符串表示形式

items.source: The String representation consists of a list of the array's elements, enclosed in curly braces ("{}"). Adjacent elements are separated by the characters ", " (a comma followed by a space). Returns a "null" String if array is null.
items.translation: String 表示形式由数组元素的列表组成，并用花括号 ("{}") 包围。相邻元素之间用字符 ", "（逗号后跟一个空格）分隔。如果 array 为 null，则返回 "null" String。

items.source: enumValues - the enum values to check, typically obtained via MyEnum.values()
items.translation: enumValues - 要检查的枚举值，通常通过 MyEnum.values() 获取。

items.source: constant - the constant name to find (must not be null or empty string)
items.translation: constant - 要查找的常量名称（不能为 null 或空字符串）

items.source: obj - the object to append
items.translation: obj - 要追加的对象

items.source: the new array (of the same component type; never null)
items.translation: 新数组（与相同组件类型；永远不为null）

items.source: whether the constant has been found in the given array
items.translation: 该常量是否已在给定数组中找到

items.source: In the context of this method, a simple value type is any of the following: primitive wrapper (excluding Void), Enum, Number, Date, Temporal, File, Path, URI, URL, InetAddress, Currency, Locale, UUID, Pattern.
items.translation: 在本方法的上下文中，简单值类型 包括以下任意一种：基本包装类（不包括 Void）、Enum、Number、 Date、Temporal、 File、Path、 URI、URL、 InetAddress、Currency、 Locale、UUID、 Pattern。

items.source: As of 7.0, the String representation is a hex-encoded string enclosed in curly braces ("{}"). The String consists of 2 hexadecimal chars per element, and without a delimiter between adjacent elements. Returns a "null" String if array is null.
items.translation: 自 7.0 版本起，String 表示形式为用花括号 ("{}") 包围的十六进制编码字符串。该 String 由每个元素 2 个十六进制字符组成，且相邻元素之间没有分隔符。如果 array 为 null，则返回 "null" String。

items.source: Differs from nullSafeToString(Object) in that it returns an empty String rather than "null" for a null value.
items.translation: 与nullSafeToString(Object)不同，对于`null`值，它返回一个空字符串而不是"null"。

items.source: Returns a "null" String if obj is null.
items.translation: 如果obj为null，则返回一个"null"字符串。

items.source: Builds a String representation of the contents in case of an array. Returns a "null" String if obj is null.
items.translation: 在数组的情况下，构建其内容的字符串表示形式。如果obj为null，则返回"null"字符串。

items.source: Favor this method over nullSafeToString(Object) when you need the length of the generated string to be limited.
items.translation: 优先使用此方法，而不是nullSafeToString(Object)，当您需要限制生成的字符串长度时。

items.source: If the given object is non-null and not one of the aforementioned supported types, this method returns false.
items.translation: 如果给定的对象非空且不属于上述支持的类型之一，此方法返回 `false`。

items.source: A null source value or empty primitive array will be converted to an empty Object array.
items.translation: null 源值或空基本类型数组将转换为空对象数组。

items.source: Compares arrays with Arrays.equals, performing an equality check based on the array elements rather than the array reference.
items.translation: 使用 `Arrays.equals` 比较数组，基于数组元素而非数组引用执行相等性检查。

items.source: Thanks to Alex Ruiz for contributing several enhancements to this class!
items.translation: 感谢 Alex Ruiz 为该类贡献了多项增强功能！

items.source: This method supports the following object types.
items.translation: 此方法支持以下对象类型。

items.source: Return a hash code for the given object, typically the value of Object.hashCode(). If the object is an array, this method will delegate to one of the Arrays.hashCode methods. If the object is null, this method returns 0.
items.translation: 返回给定对象的哈希码，通常是Object.hashCode()的值。如果对象是数组，此方法将委托给一个Arrays.hashCode 方法。如果对象为null，则此方法返回0。

items.source: Return a hash code for the given elements, delegating to nullSafeHashCode(Object) for each element. Contrary to Objects.hash(Object...), this method can handle an element that is an array.
items.translation: 返回给定元素的哈希码，为每个元素委托给nullSafeHashCode(Object)。与Objects.hash(Object...)相反，此方法可以处理元素为数组的情况。

items.source: as of 6.1 in favor of Arrays.hashCode(boolean[])
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，采用 Arrays.hashCode(boolean[])

items.source: as of 6.1 in favor of Arrays.hashCode(byte[])
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，转而使用 Arrays.hashCode(byte[])

items.source: as of 6.1 in favor of Arrays.hashCode(char[])
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，推荐使用 Arrays.hashCode(char[])。

items.source: as of 6.1 in favor of Arrays.hashCode(double[])
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，改用 Arrays.hashCode(double[])

items.source: as of 6.1 in favor of Arrays.hashCode(float[])
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，采用 Arrays.hashCode(float[])

items.source: as of 6.1 in favor of Arrays.hashCode(int[])
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，推荐使用 Arrays.hashCode(int[])。

items.source: as of 6.1 in favor of Arrays.hashCode(long[])
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，采用 Arrays.hashCode(long[])

items.source: as of 6.1 in favor of Arrays.hashCode(short[])
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，改用 Arrays.hashCode(short[])

items.source: as of 6.1 in favor of Arrays.hashCode(Object[])
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，改用 Arrays.hashCode(Object[])

items.source: Case insensitive alternative to Enum.valueOf(Class, String).
items.translation: 不区分大小写的 Enum.valueOf(Class, String) 替代方案。

items.source: Return a hash code for the given elements, delegating to nullSafeHashCode(Object) for each element.
items.translation: 返回给定元素的哈希码，为每个元素委托给 nullSafeHashCode(Object)。
